title: Supplementary Protocol for RNA SPOTs
protocol: Sonicate coverslips in 100% ethanol for 20 minutes.
Dry the coverslips with compressed air.
Dilute 2N acetic acid in water to achieve a final pH of around 3.5.
Generate a 10% (v/v) solution of the pH 3.5 acetic acid solution in 100% ethanol (Koptec).
Plasma clean dried coverslips with a plasma sterilizer (Harrick Plasma Sterilizer) for 5 minutes at HIGH setting, or soak in 1M sodium hydroxide for 20 minutes.
Immerse the coverslips immediately in the silanization reaction solution for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Triple rinse the coverslips with ethanol.
Heat-cure the coverslips at 90°C for 10 minutes.
Prepare an oligonucleotide reaction mixture containing 2.5 μM 5’-aminated LNA-oligo(dT), cyanoborohydride coupling buffer, and 1M sodium chloride.
Sandwich oligonucleotide solution between two coverslips at room temperature in a humid hybridization chamber for 3 hours.
Rinse coverslips with Millipore water and dry with compressed air.
Add quenching reaction mixture made from 10% (v/v) 100mM pH7.5 Tris-HCl buffer in cyanoborohydride coupling buffer to the silanized surface of the coverslips for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse coverslips with water and dry with compressed air.
Store functionalized coverslips in a desiccated container at 4°C for no more than 2 days if not used immediately.
Perform RNeasy Mini Kit purification according to Qiagen’s instructions.
Carry out DNase step.
Determine RNA concentration using Nanodrop after suspending RNA in water.
Use the purified RNA immediately or store it by aliquoting and keeping at -80°C.
Avoid freeze-thawing RNA multiple times during storage.
Apply customized Secure Seal Flowcell with specified parameters on freshly made functionalized poly(dT) coverslips.
Ensure adhesive is tightly sealed without air bubbles.
Prepare RNA Binding Buffer containing 1M LiCl, 40mM pH7.5 Tris-HCl, 2mM EDTA, and 0.1% Triton X-100, with 20U of SUPERase IN RNase Inhibitor.
Pre-incubate the flow cell with RNA Binding Buffer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare the desired amount of RNA in RNA Binding Buffer.
Remove pre-incubated RNA Binding Buffer from flow cell and flow in RNA solution.
Place coverslip on shaker for 2 hours at room temperature to allow RNA capture.
Prepare a fresh primary probes hybridization buffer containing 30% formamide, 2x SSC, and 10% Dextran Sulfate.
Resuspend primary probes in hybridization buffer and heat briefly at 65°C.
Remove RNA solution from flow cell and wash with 2x SSC three times.
Flow in the primary probes solution into the flow cell.
Seal inlet of flow cell with a piece of parafilm to prevent evaporation.
Place the flow cell in a humid chamber made from pipette tip box containing water.
Incubate humid chamber at 37°C for 16-24 hours.
Prepare a wash buffer solution containing 40% formamide, 2x SSC, and 0.1% Triton X-100.
Remove the primary probe solution completely from the flow cell.
Wash the flow cell with 40% wash buffer solution three times.
Incubate the sample at room temperature in 40% wash buffer solution for 30 minutes.
Remove the wash buffer and rinse the sample three times with 2x SSC.
Keep the sample in 2x SSC until the next step.
Calibrate the volume needed to flow from each loading tube to the flow cells using water before the experiment.
Prepare a 10% hybridization buffer containing 10% formamide, 2x SSC, and 10% (w/v) Dextran Sulfate.
Prepare a 20% wash buffer solution comprising of 20% formamide, 2x SSC, and 0.1% Triton X-100.
Prepare 2x SSC supplemented with 20 U/mL SUPERase IN RNase Inhibitor.
Prepare reduction buffer containing 50mM TCEP in 2x SSC with 0.1% Triton X-100.
Prepare anti-bleaching buffer base by mixing final concentrations: 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 50 mM NaCl, 3 mM Trolox, and 0.8% glucose with 20 U/mL SUPERase IN RNase Inhibitor.
Mix enzymes (final concentration: 3 U/mL pyranose oxidase or 50 U/mL of glucose oxidase) into the anti-bleaching buffer base solution.
Load secondary readout probes hybridization mixture containing 10 nM for each unique readout probe in a 10% hybridization buffer to loading tubes.
Pre-load wash buffer (20%), 2x SSC, and reduction buffer to their respective loading tubes.
Mix the anti-bleaching buffer base with enzymes, load into a tube, seal solution with a layer of mineral oil.
Hybridize primer readout probe in 10% hybridization buffer coupled to Alexa 488 alone or together with serial hybridization 1 readout probes at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Wash sample briefly with 20% wash buffer and rinse three times with 2x SSC, keeping solution in mixed anti-bleaching buffer.
Connect flow cell’s inlet to fluidic valves where solutions will flow in, connect outlet to waste.
Epoxy tubing around the inlet and outlet to ensure complete sealing.
Image the sample after multiple FOVs are selected if the first serial hybridization is done manually.
Flow in the first serial hybridization buffer after selecting multiple FOVs using signals from 488 channels for automated delivery and imaging.
Proceed with solution delivery as follows:
Serial hybridization
20% wash
2x SSC wash
Anti-bleaching buffer
Imaging
TCEP reduction buffer post-imaging
2x SSC wash pre-hybridization of the next round.
Take multispectral beads images manually after 20 rounds of serial hybridizations for image analysis.
